evidence: We have established an Artificial Intelligence ( AI ) Council to explore and implement AI-driven solutions across various business operations.
This Council, composed of cross-functional leaders and experts, is focused on automating routine processes, enhancing data analytics capabilities, and improving decision-making frameworks.
The AI Council is also responsible for addressing potential risks associated with AI implementation, including data privacy, security, and ethical considerations.
ai_positioning.summary: La société ALGT utilise l'IA en interne pour automatiser les processus et améliorer l'analyse des données, avec un conseil dédié pour explorer et mettre en œuvre des solutions AI.
